lines.text: Many learners say: Actually, I am studying now.
Better: Right now, I am studying.
Right now! Right now, I am at work.

native.tip: “Actually” quer dizer “na verdade”. Para “agora”, use “right now”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “Actually, I am studying now.”. O certo é “Right now, I am studying.”. Cuidado: é um falso cognato clássico. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “Right now”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “Actually, I am studying now.”. The right way is “Right now, I am studying.”. Careful: it is a classic false friend. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
